about: The four cyberware chips special zombies drop. Installing one is permanent until you go down (like a perk). The chip you pick up is the next one you don't have yet, in random order.

columns.model: models sheet id of the model the effect shows, or none
columns.tested_in_game: true once picked up and used in Kino
